title:
On the Johnson–Tzitzeica Theorems and the Yang–Baxter
Equations
content:
: The current paper deals with the sets of Johnson circles, and to the famous Yang-
Baxter equations. The Johnson–Tzitzeica theorem could be considered a result related to
symmetry. we will also present an asymmetric construction related to the Johnson–Tzitzeica
theorem. Then, there is a special section discussing on the Yang-Baxter equations. The
concluding section attempts to connect the two above topics.
